context: A retired exec mentors on succession
purpose: Teach: （株）/小生/亭/竹中/ニッポン放送/世田谷/キャピタル/人組

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 我が（株）も、創業から長いな。
lines.en: Our company has been around a long time since we started it.
lines.style: Unhurried, distant in time. Slow cadence. Settles each word like placing a stone. Breath carries the weight of decades. No rush to finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。小生も、引き継ぎを意識しています。
lines.en: Yes. I've been thinking about how to pass it on.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register. Measured and deliberate. Each phrase distinct. Shows he's been carrying this thought carefully. Not casual — this is preparation speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業の九段亭、まだ営業してるか。
lines.en: The Kudan-tei from our founding days — is it still operating?
lines.style: Soft searching quality. Voice lifts slightly at the question mark — genuine curiosity, not rhetorical. Nostalgia touches the edges but doesn't overwhelm. Breath before the name.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。竹中先生も、ニッポン放送の番組で当時を語っていました。
lines.en: Yes. Even Takenaka-san mentioned those days during his appearance on Nippon Broadcasting.
lines.style: Proud, specific detail. Leans in on the reference — this is evidence, proof that the era matters. Slight uplift at the end. Matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 世田谷の本社、若手が中心に。キャピタル管理、3人組の重鎮で守れ。
lines.en: Get the Setagaya headquarters focused on younger leadership. Three of our senior people hold the line on capital management.
lines.style: Clear instruction, no softening. Direct eye contact implied in the voice. Confident but not unkind. Each clause lands decisively. The weight of experience giving an order that will hold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Crisp, immediate. Single breath. Shows respect and readiness in one word. No elaboration needed — the message is received and held.
